posts.text: REPORT Overnight, Russia carried out a large-scale attack on Zaporizhzhia City using Geran-2 drones and Geran-4 jet-drones. The targets of the attack included an industrial enterprise, an electrical substation, bridges across the Dnieper River, as well as the city's hydroelectric power plant. A large fire broke out at the industrial enterprise following the attack. While the condition of the bridges and hydroelectric power plant is currently unknown, traffic across them in both directions was briefly suspended before being restored two different times, indicating only limited damage. Iran says two oil tankers hit naval mines in Strait of Hormuz Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) says two oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, north of Khasab Port. According to the IRGC, the vessels were travelling along a route Tehran considers unauthorised, with their navigation systems switched off. Iran says one of the tankers was carrying more than two million barrels of crude oil and was left burning after the explosion. The incidents come amid an increase in attacks and threats against vessels passing through the strategic waterway. Tehran insists that ships must obtain clearance from Iranian authorities to transit the strait, and has described vessels using unauthorised routes as legitimate targets.
